descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Johannesburg puts you in the captain's seat over the real City of Gold.

THE REAL JOBURG
Real satellite, elevation and map data a mile above the sea: the Hillbrow Tower, Ponte, the Carlton Centre, the Mandela Bridge, Sandton's Leonardo, FNB Stadium's calabash, the Orlando Towers, Gold Reef City, the mine dumps and their headgears, the Union Buildings, the Voortrekker Monument, the Hartbeespoort Dam. Four airports: O.R. Tambo, Lanseria, Rand and AFB Waterkloof.

A LIVING CITY
The Gautrain and Metrorail on their real tracks, minibus taxis and Rea Vaya buses on the roads, airliners in O.R. Tambo's streams. At night Sandton, Hillbrow and the CBD light up and the highveld storms flash on the horizon.

AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL
A real-sounding radio: taxi and takeoff clearances, departure, traffic calls, the ILS and your landing clearance, with chatter between airliners.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your glass hangar on the Wemmer Pan, the Hillbrow Tower and Ponte out of the doors. Walk around, repaint, wash, fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with walk-through cabins, a midsize jet with yokes and a twin-engine fighter.

MISSIONS AND FREE FLIGHT
Eleven missions: the O.R. Tambo approach, Lanseria over the Cradle, a low Soweto run, BETWEEN the Orlando Towers, Pretoria's jacarandas, a Waterkloof fighter scramble, Sandton after dark and a Joburg tour.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
